title: Pilot knowledge requirements
description: Requirements for ontology concept selection. Operational descriptions are supplied in English with their original requirement references.

pilot_id.description: Site identifier matching pilot setup and enrolment inputs.

language.description: The current encoder uses English descriptions; the pilot's participant languages are configured separately.

status.description: Identifies the provenance context, not whether the requirements have been reviewed.

source.description: Description of the original pilot requirements or source documents.

owner.description: Person, role or team responsible for the operational requirement set.

text.description: A readable knowledge need, without prescribing the expected ontology class.

source_refs.description: Original requirement IDs, form sections or document references retained for traceability.
